push:
Blazers @ Timberwolves 6/10 7:00 - Both banged up, still a close one
Rockets @ Heat 5/10 6:30 - Houston short on bigs, Amen questionable
Grizzlies @ Wizards 5/10 6:00 - Young teams, Edey questionable, Memphis thin

games.notes: Edwards out for Minnesota; Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe out for Portland. Two good teams with depleted rosters, should be close and scrappy.
Capela and Adams out, Amen Thompson questionable, Smart suspended for Houston; Heat missing Larsson. The better team is thin up front, so Miami has a real shot.
Edey and Post questionable, Stewart, Jerome and Pippen out for Memphis; Tre Johnson questionable for Washington. Young rosters, Memphis should still win but it is a thin watch.
Embiid questionable, LeBron out for Philadelphia. Contender against a bottom team, likely a Sixers win and only worth it if Embiid plays.
Banchero and Isaac out for Orlando. Hot Celtics against a short-handed mid team, likely blowout.
Mark Williams out, Dunn questionable for Phoenix. Jokic is healthy and Denver should cruise against a team going nowhere.
Mobley and Merrill out for Cleveland, Caleb Wilson out for Chicago. Two teams going nowhere, skip it.
No Curry, Butler or Porzingis for Golden State; Murphy and Mathurin out for New Orleans. Two gutted rosters, nothing to see.

tiers: Contender: Spurs, Thunder, Knicks, 76ers, Celtics, Lakers, Rockets, Timberwolves | Young & fun: Pistons, Mavericks, Raptors, Trail Blazers, Grizzlies, Wizards | Mid: Cavaliers, Heat, Pacers, Nuggets, Hawks, Magic, Warriors | Tanking or boring: Bulls, Bucks, Kings, Clippers, Pelicans, Suns, Hornets, Nets, Jazz | Tier moves: Warriors contender to mid for today (Curry out with oblique tear, Butler out until Jan-Feb, Porzingis away, Moody out)
